en.name: Rule of Three
en.description: A 60-90 second charge-up rock-paper-scissors duel: charge slots are public, so you read declarations, not memory.

zh-cn.name: 拳律
zh-cn.description: 60-90 秒一局的蓄力猜拳对决：蓄力槽全公开，读的是宣告不是记忆。

promptHint.en: Use when the player explicitly asks to play rock-paper-scissors or a charge-up RPS duel, or the scene genuinely calls for a short one-on-one mind-game match against the current character.
promptHint.zh-cn: 玩家明确要玩石头剪刀布/猜拳蓄力对决，或剧情确实需要与当前角色来一场简短的一对一斗心眼比试时使用。

avoidHint.en: Do not launch for casual mentions of fists, punches, or rock-paper-scissors in ordinary conversation.
avoidHint.zh-cn: 普通对话里只是随口提到拳头、出拳或猜拳时不要拉起。
